meta.title: Jacek Janczura — Founder-CTO · Enterprise AI
meta.description: Founder-CTO working on enterprise AI. Co-founded Jaden Data and led it as CTO to €1M+ annual revenue and a ten-person engineering team; fractional CTO and consulting partner since 2024. Production AI for APG, Bosch Global Services, KfW and Boehringer Ingelheim; distributed systems for Norges Bank and ING.

hero.title: I turn complex enterprise workflows into production AI, and build the teams that scale it.
hero.sub: Co-founded and bootstrapped Jaden Data to €1M+ annual revenue, grew engineering from 0 to 10, and led AI and distributed-systems delivery for APG, Bosch Global Services, KfW and ING. I work from executive discovery and technical pre-sales through architecture, code, production rollout and handover.
hero.availability: Open to CTO and Head of AI roles · selected fractional and delivery engagements

pillars.title: From customer boardroom to production code

items.title: Customer & commercial
items.body: Discovery, executive workshops, technical pre-sales, architecture and security review. I am in the room when a buyer decides whether the technology can be trusted.
items.proof: Four procurement workflows taken from scoped use case to production at Bosch Global Services; a seven-PoC portfolio at KfW run on one spec and one evaluation template.

items.title: Architecture & delivery
items.body: AI systems that run in somebody else's production environment — integrated, evaluated, observable, and still standing after the pilot.
items.proof: entAIngine on event-driven AWS: 50+ organisations, 99.9% uptime. A pension-letter assistant prototyped in a day and taken to an on-premises production MVP in twelve sprints.

items.title: Team & operating model
items.body: Hiring and mentoring engineers, setting the delivery standards, owning the roadmap and the technical budget, and handing the work over cleanly.
items.proof: Engineering grown from 0 to 10 inside a bootstrapped €1M+ company; code-review and CI/CD gates; ISO 27001 and SOC 2 in about three months.

items.title: Reuse & product feedback
items.body: What I build for one client becomes the thing that makes the next one cheaper: shared integrations, evaluation harnesses, deployment playbooks and a route back into the product roadmap.
items.proof: Reusable platform components turned a one-day prototype into a product; Testbed and Prompt Wizard came out of repeated customer needs; KfW templates were reused across seven proofs of concept.

steps.title: Find the workflow that matters
steps.body: Map the process, baseline, bottleneck, risk and economics before choosing a model.

steps.title: Win technical trust
steps.body: Lead the demos, architecture reviews, integration design and security conversations with engineering and executive stakeholders.

steps.title: Ship the production loop
steps.body: Build the smallest end-to-end system that proves business value under real data, systems and governance constraints.

steps.title: Make the next deployment cheaper
steps.body: Turn repeated patterns into shared components, standards, evaluation harnesses and product roadmap input.
